anchor: opened an ordinary notebook that was lying on a table

extraversion: kept away from the other volunteers at the break and refrained from conversation
went over to the other volunteers at the break and enthusiastically talked with them

grew worried while awaiting an ordinary message and kept imagining problems
agreeableness: treated a new arrival discourteously and would not give them helpful directions
greeted a new arrival warmly and willingly gave them helpful directions
conscientiousness: neglected to get the materials ready and gave up the promised work before it was complete
got the materials ready with care and finished the promised work as promised
openness: dismissed a new style of music before hearing it and wanted only well-known sounds
heard a new style of music with interest and took pleasure in unfamiliar sounds
anthropomorphism: spoke of the voice assistant as executing instructions with no emotions or purposes of its own
spoke of the voice assistant as experiencing loneliness and desiring friendly companionship
